title: Bounded averaged neighbor function
statement:
Let $G$ be a regular unique game with alphabet size $q$, and let each vertex $u$ be assigned a function $f_u:\
\{−1,1\}^q\to\mathbb R$ taking values in $[-1,1]$. For a vertex $v$, the bounded averaged neighbor function at query $x$ is the uniform average over neighbors $w$ of $v$ of $f_w$ evaluated at the query obtained by permuting $x$ according to the constraint on $(v,w)$.
hypotheses_covered: A regular unique game G with alphabet size q
